about: SummitLine audio made with ElevenLabs (Creator plan, commercial licence) on 2026-09-28. "gain" brings each file to a common loudness (sound effects and voice about -20 dBFS RMS, music about -26 so it sits under them), with the peak kept under -1 dBFS. Multiply your own volume by it.

sfx/crowd.mp3.what: crowd cheering at a ski race finish line, cowbells
